en.t: So it was the teacher after all.

units.source_text: 为什么方才同我擦身而过的老师和那女人转了一圈后又复与我相遇呢？

en.t: Why had the teacher who had just brushed past me, together with that woman, gone around in a circle and then met me again?
I had no way of knowing.

units.source_text: 总之，他就是老师，先行上车的女人身穿的大衣的褐红色，以及方才见过的颜色都留在我的记忆里。

en.t: In any case, he was the teacher, and the reddish brown of the coat worn by the woman who had boarded the car first, together with the color I had seen a moment earlier, remained in my memory.
